Bulk-action dialogs, Exportar confirm, Atribuir confirm, page-size change and real file upload not exercised

scope: /pnip/portal-mpa/vistorias (tabs Agendar, Tramitando, Concluídos; filters; search; date filter; table actions; pagination; user menu; dialogs Atribuir/Excluir/Notificar/Exportar)
/pnip/portal-mpa/vistorias/agendar-vistoria/:id (from Agendar row action and eye action)
report.notes: Viewport 1280x900 measured. Tools: govbr-ds-validator scan_page S-page-001..010, verify_finding V-001..V-006 (V-001/V-002 unverifiable due to citation/locator, re-done as V-003). Many controls live in shadow DOM of br-* web components; selectors point to light-DOM hosts (br-button, br-input, br-header, br-breadcrumb). Not executed: actual deletion (cancelled), Agendar with a real file (upload not keyboard reachable; file chooser not exercised), Exportar confirm, Atribuir OK, bulk actions "Notificar Selecionadas"/"Alterar vistoriador em lote", page-size change, Voltar/Home and "Trocar unidade" destinations (outside /vistorias). Map in edit route disabled in mock. Only 1280 width in scope.

findings.observed: The 10 eye-icon action buttons (one per row) render an inner <button aria-label=""> with only an aria-hidden icon and no title: no accessible name.
findings.expected: Each icon-only button has an accessible name (e.g. aria-label "Visualizar vistoria").

findings.observed: The two date-range inputs (#br-input-8, #br-input-9 inside br-input) have no label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; "Data da vistoria:" and "até" are plain text not associated.
findings.expected: Each date field has a programmatically associated label (e.g. "Data da vistoria – início/fim").

findings.observed: Select-all checkbox in the header and the 10 row checkboxes have no label/aria-label.
findings.expected: Each checkbox has an accessible name (e.g. "Selecionar todas", "Selecionar vistoria Coral Mansa IV").

findings.observed: Search field has only placeholder "Pesquise aqui ..." as its label; no <label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby.
findings.expected: Search field has a persistent, programmatically associated label.

findings.observed: Status badge "Vistoria agendada": white #ffffff text, 14px normal, on #4f97d1 — contrast 3.14:1.
findings.expected: Text contrast at least 4.5:1.

findings.observed: On tab "Agendar", status badge "Vistoria pré agendada": white text 14px on #888888 — contrast 3.54:1.
findings.expected: Text contrast at least 4.5:1.

findings.observed: Tag "Nenhum filtro de data aplicado": white text 14px on #c5d4eb — contrast 1.5:1.
findings.expected: Text contrast at least 4.5:1.

findings.observed: Header cell of the actions column is empty (no text, no accessible name).
findings.expected: Every column header has text (e.g. "Ações", visually hidden if needed).

findings.observed: Pagination page numbers are <li> elements nested directly inside another <li> (li > li), invalid list structure.
findings.expected: Each page item is a single <li> child of the <ul>.

findings.observed: Current page link is indicated only by class "active"; no aria-current="page" (checked on page 1 and after moving to page 2).
findings.expected: Current page exposed programmatically (aria-current="page").

findings.observed: Focusing page link "3" and pressing Enter loads the page but focus goes to <body> (links are re-rendered).
findings.expected: Focus stays on the activated page link (or moves to a logical place like the results).

findings.observed: Tabs Agendar/Tramitando/Concluídos are plain buttons; the selected tab is only shown by class "active" on the <li> (no role=tab, aria-selected or aria-current).
findings.expected: Selected state is exposed programmatically (tablist/tab + aria-selected, or aria-current).

findings.observed: Filter triggers Cidade/Porto/Vistoriador/Status are <span> with cursor:pointer and click handlers, tabIndex -1, no role: not reachable or operable by keyboard (skipped in Tab sequence).
findings.expected: Filter triggers are buttons operable by keyboard, with expanded state.

findings.observed: Options of an opened filter (e.g. Cidade) are <label> elements inside .br-radio with no input and no role; not focusable, only selectable by mouse click.
findings.expected: Options are focusable radio/option controls operable by keyboard.

findings.observed: Applied filter tag ("Enseada Clara") has a remove button with only an icon (fa-times) and no accessible name.
findings.expected: The remove button has a name such as "Remover filtro Enseada Clara".

findings.observed: No skip link: the first link on the page is the breadcrumb "Home" (href=/portal-mpa); first Tab stop is the header Menu button.
findings.expected: A "Ir para o conteúdo" skip link as first focusable element.

findings.observed: No footer region (.br-footer / br-footer) in the document on the list page and internal routes.
findings.expected: Template Base footer present.

findings.observed: Page has no h1; the page title "Vistorias" is an h2 and the only heading.
findings.expected: Main page heading is h1, followed by a consistent hierarchy.

findings.observed: Header gov.br logo image has alt="logo" (shadow root of br-header), which does not convey the image content.
findings.expected: Meaningful alt, e.g. "gov.br".

findings.observed: Header "Menu" button (#navigation, data-target="#main-navigation") does nothing when clicked: #main-navigation does not exist and no menu opens; no aria-expanded.
findings.expected: The menu button opens the main navigation (or is removed if there is no menu).

findings.observed: Breadcrumb Home item is an <a href="/portal-mpa"> wrapping a <button> (nested interactive controls, two Tab stops for one item).
findings.expected: A single link with an accessible name "Home"/"Página inicial".

findings.observed: User menu trigger shows visible text "Olá, Usuária de Teste, SUPERVISOR" but aria-label is "Avatar com dropdown", which does not contain the visible text.
findings.expected: Accessible name contains the visible label text.

findings.observed: Open user menu has role="menu" but its children are a div, span and a plain <button> ("Sair"); no menuitem children.
findings.expected: role=menu only with menuitem children, or no menu role.

findings.observed: "Sair" exit icon has no alt attribute.
findings.expected: Decorative image has alt="" (text "Sair" already present).

findings.observed: "Trocar unidade" is a <span> with cursor:pointer that navigates on click (to /portal-mpa) but has tabIndex -1 and no role: not keyboard operable.
findings.expected: Actionable item is a link/button reachable and operable by keyboard.

findings.observed: With the user menu open and focus on the trigger, pressing Escape does not close it (menu stays visible, aria-expanded stays true).
findings.expected: Escape closes the dropdown and keeps focus on the trigger.

findings.observed: "Atribuir Vistoriador" dialog: the vistoriador <select> (initially focused) has no label; "Selecione um Vistoriador" is not associated.
findings.expected: Select has an associated label.

findings.observed: After closing the "Atribuir Vistoriador" dialog with Cancelar, focus goes to <body> instead of returning to the invoking button.
findings.expected: Focus returns to the control that opened the dialog.

findings.observed: In rows with an assigned inspector the button shows the user-times ("remove user") icon but has title "Atribuir vistoriador" and opens the same assign dialog as the user-plus icon.
findings.expected: Icon and name consistently represent the same action.

findings.observed: At 1280 px the table (1272 px) overflows its 1096 px container with overflow visible; document scrollWidth 1364 > 1280, last action column (Notificar) is cut at the viewport edge and the page scrolls horizontally.
findings.expected: Table fits its container or scrolls inside its own container (DS responsive table).

findings.observed:
Searching "zzzz" replaces results with

Não há vistorias para exibir.

with no role=status/aria-live; the aria-live pagination info is removed, so nothing is announced.
findings.expected: The empty-result message is a status message (role=status/aria-live).

findings.observed: Agendar vistoria: required upload "Boleto ... ART" uses a <div class="upload-file"> click target with hidden input[type=file].d-none; not focusable (Tab goes Editar → Voltar → Agendar), label has no for.
findings.expected: File upload reachable and operable by keyboard with associated label (DS br-upload).

findings.observed: Agendar vistoria: clicking Agendar without file opens "Atenção – Formulário preenchido incorretamente"; after closing (Escape) focus goes to <body>.
findings.expected: Focus returns to the invoker or to the field in error.

findings.observed: Agendar vistoria route: first heading is h3 ("Programa Nacional ...") followed by h4; no h1/h2.
findings.expected: Heading hierarchy starting at h1 without skipped levels.

findings.observed: <title> is "PNIP" on the list and on the agendar-vistoria and editar-dados-vistoria routes; it does not describe each page.
findings.expected: Unique, descriptive title per page (e.g. "Agendar vistoria - Vistorias - PNIP").

findings.observed: Editar dados da vistoria: "Boleto ART" upload ("Selecione o arquivo") is a non-focusable div with hidden file input; not keyboard operable.
findings.expected: Keyboard-operable upload with associated label.

findings.observed: Editar dados da vistoria: disabled vistoriador fields are validated as required; Salvar always fails with "Campo obrigatório" on them and "Preencha todos os campos obrigatórios", and the user cannot fill them here nor is told how.
findings.expected: Disabled fields are not required here, or the message explains how to fix (assign a vistoriador).

findings.observed: After Salvar, "Campo obrigatório" (role=alert) is rendered outside br-input; the inner inputs have no aria-invalid and no aria-describedby to the message.
findings.expected: Fields in error marked aria-invalid=true and linked to their error text.

findings.observed: Editar dados da vistoria: fields that are required (error "Campo obrigatório" when emptied) have no asterisk, "obrigatório" text or required/aria-required before submission.
findings.expected: Required fields indicated in the label and programmatically.

findings.observed: Editar dados: after Salvar shows "Atenção – Preencha todos os campos obrigatórios" and the dialog is closed with Escape, focus goes to <body>.
findings.expected: Focus returns to invoker or first field in error.

findings.observed: Editar dados da vistoria route: first heading is h3, then h4; no h1/h2.
findings.expected: Heading hierarchy starting at h1.

findings.observed: "Limpar Filtro" button has inline margin-top: -5px, outside the DS spacing scale.
findings.expected: Spacing from DS spacing tokens.

findings.observed: Search button has inline margin-top: -38px, outside the DS spacing scale.
findings.expected: Spacing from DS spacing tokens.

findings.observed: User-menu divider border-top-color #bbbbbb does not match any DS color token.
findings.expected: DS color token for dividers.
